decisions.scope: Prospective feature cleanup plus publication/highlight annotations; accepted truth, language and frozen worlds stay unchanged.
decisions.fixed_useful_facts: Store as construction/care literals rather than independent variance features.
decisions.joint_features: Variable fact fields are not independent draws: the two existing joint recipes and their dependencies remain unchanged.
decisions.family_defaults: No invented defaults for this neutral tops base; add only after reviewing the wider family and exceptions.
decisions.disclosure: Select semantic groups once per retailer/product; no per-navigation redraw. No count/probability tuning in this draft.
decisions.display_grouping: Display groups place already-selected statements together; they do not merge factual meanings or force complete disclosure. All selected washing/drying/bleaching/dry-cleaning/ironing statements share one Care instructions area, normally prose.
decisions.highlights: Website chooses count/placement from disclosed, known/applicable candidates; priorities rank desirability, not sampling probabilities.
decisions.scoped_quantities: Preserve source subject, units and measurement/component bases; duplicate qualifier strings are not separate features.
decisions.false_zero: No blanket exclusion. Plain finish and prohibitions in selected care groups remain meaningful.
decisions.truth_and_omission: Unpublished known facts, genuinely unknown facts and not-applicable fields remain distinct.
decisions.unknown_publication: Removing an always-unknown placeholder does not declare the fact known or false. A direct question must still be treated as unsupported.
decisions.prose: Existing multi-fact paragraphs cannot be blindly reused after pruning; reauthor eligible groups using existing assertion IDs/scopes.

main_fabric.label: Main fabric
main_fabric.note: Cotton percentage describes body/sleeve fabric, excluding trim, thread and labels.

fabric_weight.label: Fabric weight
fabric_weight.note: A known weight label remains useful when nominal g/m² is unknown; never infer garment mass.

style.label: Sleeves, hem and plain finish
style.note: Fixed useful style information is literal content, not a variation dimension.

machine_wash.label: Machine washing
machine_wash.note: Permission, maximum temperature and cycle form one scoped care statement.

ironing.label: Ironing
ironing.note: Main-cloth permission/temperature and neck-trim exclusion must travel together.

care.label: Care instructions
care.note: One display area for all selected care statements; individual care disclosure groups remain separately selectable.

sku_notes.size_guide: sku.nominal_chart_back_length_cm can be optional size-guide evidence with its nominal/pre-wash basis; not a highlight.
sku_notes.unknown_actual_measurements: Permanent unknown actual garment/body/whole-purchase measurements are not useful product variance or automatic retailer details.
sku_notes.identity_and_commerce: Keep actual SKU identity, listed options, pack quantity, payable prices, stock and delivery contracts.

research.observation: Published product identity emphasizes relaxed fit and fabric weight.
Product description, scoped material information and care are separate from size/colour buying controls.
